name: SDIT Cahaya Quran Depok

notes.id: Biaya masuk gelombang sudah termasuk uang pangkal, seragam 6 setel, uang kegiatan dan buku 1 tahun. SPP kelas 1–3 Rp750.000; kelas 4–6 Rp850.000.
notes.en: Entry fee includes uang pangkal, 6 uniform sets, and one year of activities and books. Tuition grades 1–3 Rp750,000; grades 4–6 Rp850,000.
